name: flow-to-feed
description: Turn technical Markdown into editable Mermaid diagrams and channel-specific visual lessons, ready to review and share.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowtofeed/shared && npm run build -w @flowtofeed/api && npm run build -w @flowtofeed/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flowtofeed/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
